Promotions panel added. I haven't run the app, a typecheck or any tests. The `fullstack_check` tool was also denied permission, so that check didn't run. `fullstack_find` was denied too, so I used Grep and Glob to find the code.

- **Page:** `/admin/promotions` is a new route at `app/admin/promotions/page.tsx`. It sits inside the existing admin layout, so the same auth applies.
- **List:** `components/admin/AdminPromotionsView.tsx` loads `GET /api/admin/promotions`. It shows a table with code, title, discount, used/limit, expiry and status, plus a Refresh button. It also has loading, error and empty states.
- **Delete:** each row has a Delete button. It asks for confirmation, calls `DELETE /api/admin/promotions?id=…`, then removes the row and shows a toast. A failed delete shows an error toast.
- **Nav:** I added a "Promotions" link to the Commerce section of `AdminSidebar.tsx`, between Offers and Orders.

The panel only lists and deletes. There is no create or edit form, even though the API supports creating promotions.
